quarterly_data.quarter: Hirata Corporation results presentation: FY2026 Q1 Financial Results Explanatory Materials (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (three months to June 30, 2026; FY2026 = year ending March 31, 2027) consolidated results: orders received JPY 31,018 million (+25.6%), net sales JPY 25,883 million (+17.0%), operating profit JPY 3,868 million (+125.7%), order backlog JPY 56,931 million (-3.5%). The company says semiconductor-related orders grew significantly, driven by demand associated with generative AI, and semiconductor-related sales rose on the increased orders; the quarter's profit included a refund of costs associated with additional U.S. tariffs (impact limited to the current quarter).

quarterly_data.quarter: Hirata Corporation results presentation: FY2026 Q1 Financial Results Explanatory Materials (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Business description: the semiconductor-related business makes load ports that transfer silicon wafers to process tools, wafer handling robots for atmospheric and vacuum environments and EFEMs integrating them, used mainly in front-end processes (an EFEM and load port per process tool, several per production line); main customers are domestic equipment manufacturers and device manufacturers / foundries. Growth area: EFEMs, load ports and handling robots for panel-level packaging (PLP) panel substrates. It also supplies substrate handling systems to domestic substrate manufacturers.
